pieces.Text: When using her surprise accuracy rage power, the barbarian's critical multiplier for damage increases by 1 (a ?2 multiplier becomes ?3, a 19-20/?2 multiplier becomes 19-20/?3, a x3 multiplier becomes x4, and a x4 multiplier becomes x5). While in the accurate stance, your critical multiplier for damage increases by 1 (a x2 multiplier becomes x3, a x3 multiplier becomes x4, and a x4 multiplier becomes x5).
